h1250_b_v1_degeneracy_and_v2_amendment.discovery: The v1 B selector chose by recall@30, but H/G/C/M/P/T only reorder the same fixed core6+tail24 bank. Therefore recall@30 is identical across all six rankers by construction, and the prior-only selector is guaranteed to tie and choose H.
h1250_b_v1_degeneracy_and_v2_amendment.timing: Detected by code/spec audit before any H1250-A/B outer evaluation was executed.
h1250_b_v1_degeneracy_and_v2_amendment.new_objective: Equal-weight macro-average candidate recall fraction across K=10,15,20,25,30 over the prior 150 completed targets.
h1250_b_v1_degeneracy_and_v2_amendment.selection_rule: For each of the prior 150 completed targets, calculate recall fraction at each of the five registered K values; average equally across K, then average across prior targets. Select the highest ranker, tie-break H,G,C,M,P,T, and freeze for the next 50-target block.
h1250_b_v1_degeneracy_and_v2_amendment.reason_for_amendment: The v1 objective was mathematically non-identifiable for ranker selection. The v2 amendment uses the already registered recall@10/15/20/25/30 metrics and was made before reading any outer evaluation results. It does not change the strict gate or choose a model from outcome performance.
